B0G2LTBM1M.title: SONOFF Zigbee 3.0 & Thread USB Dongle (Dongle-LMG21)
bullets: Reliable EFR32MG21 chip. Built with the proven EFR32MG21 chipset, this USB dongle offers low-latency communication and excellent compatibility with Zigbee 3.0 devices—ideal for building a dependable smart-home network.
Compact & Easy to Install. The lightweight, compact design fits conveniently in crowded USB ports on PCs, mini-servers, or Raspberry Pi, making it suitable for any smart-home setup.

Includes USB extension cable. Comes with a USB extension cable to help position the dongle away from USB 3.0 interference sources, improving signal strength and ensuring more stable Zigbee and Thread network performance.

B0FMJH4DPN.title: SONOFF Zigbee/Thread PoE Dongle Max (Dongle-M)
bullets: High-Performance Chip. Powered by the advanced EFR32MG24 and ESP32D0WDR2 combo, Dongle Max unlocks faster processing, reliable connections, and endless possibilities for future growth.

Flexible Connectivity. Supports Ethernet, Wi-Fi, and USB connections, giving you the freedom to deploy Dongle Max wherever it fits best. Enjoy placement flexibility and wireless connectivity across your space.

B0H5HYZ3LP.title: SONOFF Zigbee USB Dongle Plus CC2674P10(Dongle-PP10)
bullets: Next-Gen TI CC2674P10 – Flagship chip supporting large Zigbee/Thread devices. Built for heavy automation & large mesh networks.

B0H7BQVT8F.title: SONOFF Bridge Max Smart Home Hub (Bridge-M)
bullets: Matter Bridge for Smart Home Integration: Bridge Zigbee, BTHome, and eWeLink devices to Matter platforms such as Alexa, Google Home, and Apple Home. Connect different smart home ecosystems and enjoy seamless cross-platform device control.

Local Web Console, No Cloud Required: Access the local Matter Bridge web interface directly from your LAN without downloading an app or relying on cloud services. Configure and manage device bridging while keeping your data private and secure.

Smart Home Security Protection: Pair with Zigbee sensors to create a local home security system. When intrusion is detected, the built-in 90 dB alarm and instant mobile notifications help keep you informed and your home protected.

Support Home Assistant: Easily integrate Zigbee devices with Home Assistant through MQTT or bridge Home Assistant devices to Matter-compatible platforms, enabling greater flexibility across your smart home setup.

Zigbee Hub with Broad Compatibility: Works as a Zigbee Hub and Zigbee Gateway, supporting SONOFF and a wide range of third-party Zigbee devices. Create local automations and build a reliable, connected smart home experience.

B0DJNKTCFY.title: Tuya Smart Multi-Mode Gateway, Zigbee 3.0, BLE, Bluetooth Mesh, Smart Home Wireless Hub for Home Automation, Wifi 2.4G/5G Dual-band, APP Control, Voice Control, Compatible with Alexa, Google Assistant
B0DJNKTCFY.availability: Only 10 left in stock - order soon.
bullets: [Multi-Mode Wireless Gateway] IFTTT support. This tuya smart home bridge supports protocols of zigbee, BLE, bluetooth mesh. The three protocols are interoperable, no matter whether your devices support zigbee, BLE or bluetooth mesh, you can control them together through the Smart Gateway on the Smart Life app. When configuring the network, please connect your phone to the wifi to ensure that the phone and the smart gateway are in the same wifi network, 2.4G/5G Dual-band wifi for more stable device connection.

[Unique Features] The gateway supports suspension mounting and has enough small holes on its back to improve internal heat dissipation. Type-c power supplies comply with the latest EU regulations. Proximity, high capacity, high stability, low power consumption, low data rate, more suitable for indoor smart home system self-organizing network, in which the dynamic routing to achieve high reliability, no fear of disconnecting from the Ethernet, a single node to lose the response still exists in the communication capacity.

[Tuya Cloud Massive Product Code Base] 11000+ products are interconnected, and the cloud service is stable, reliable and low power consumption. Support up to 128 zigbee/bluetooth mesh tuya smart home devices which base on tuya platform and support 2 BLE devices concurrently. For example, you can control multiple ZigBee devices, such as door and window sensors, infrared sensors, converters, lights, smart water leak detector, smart sockets, temperature and humidity sensors, and so on. In addition, it can also easily control Bluetooth protocol smart finger robots and so on.

[Smart Home Control Center] Supports remote control via mobile app. It will receive signals from sub-devices and upload them to the cloud server. You will be able to view device data in real-time and remotely control its operating state on the app. Configuring multiple devices in a single account can achieve smart scenarios. With a single app, you can easily control your home and pair it with various smart devices and their accessories to make your home smart. You can set various scenarios by exploring scenarios, allowing smart devices in your home to achieve intelligent linkage and meet your various smart life needs.

[Support voice control] Supports most of the voice speakers on the market, such as Google Home, Alexa, and also SiRi. e.g. you can say 'Google Home, turn off the finger robot in the kitchen', and you can also send a voice command to say: 'Alexa, turn on the ZigBee Valve Controller for Bedroom'.
